turns.prompt: What are the total invoices related to cloud?

response_json.content:
There are 4 cloud-related invoices in total: 1 invoice for €800.00 and 3 invoices totaling $73,612.43, all inbound.

response_json.generated_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
  SUM(grand_total) AS total_amount,
  SUM(CASE WHEN flow_direction = 'INBOUND' THEN grand_total ELSE 0 END) AS total_inbound,
  SUM(CASE WHEN flow_direction = 'OUTBOUND' THEN grand_total ELSE 0 END) AS total_outbound,
  currency
FROM invoice
WHERE tenant_id = '02db74f3-2064-4b3b-aec9-218af9a408f4'
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(vendor_name, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(customer_name, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(tags::text, '')) LIKE LOWER('%"cloud"%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(items::text, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(file_path, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(invoice_number, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
  )
GROUP BY currency;
